## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 11 abr 2026 - 19 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios reportan problemas de fiabilidad. Apunta a gaps de calidad que un competidor puede explotar.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Mukul Gupta_, 17 jul 2026, 1/5: "Overtime this has only got more buggy and laggy. Not what I expected after buying the premium subscription."
            2. _Antony Filyk_, 19 jul 2026, 2/5: "They've added subscription-based monetisation after I already purchased premium. Also, there is this annoying red dot notification that doesn't go away no matter what you do. The UI is buggy, for the subscription based service with heavy in-app monetisation this is a really bad business practice. I don't like how this app that supposedly should help battle distractions becomes the distraction itself."
            3. _Jasmin Rother-Struck_, 17 jul 2026, 3/5: "It is ok. At least you can use it. But there is a bug, where I join a room and I got kicked out immediately. I joint 2 to 3 rooms - always the same. When I do rooms, I got messages from another participants, that they got kicked out of the room. Please fix this. And BTW: Please don't use AI for trees. You are claiming, that you care about the environment yet you use AI for your trees. Atp this app is greenwashing"

## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Precio y paywall.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 25 ene 2026 - 19 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _w y_, 9 jul 2026, 1/5: "paid for forest plus and still got ads (not the optional ones for extra rewards)"
            2. _hyjdidnfb_, 10 jun 2026, 1/5: "i liked the app but that you paywall something that i initially payey for is so greedy. i want to see my tags and pie charts as an overview. why do i see advertisement in an app i payed for!!!"
            3. _Ananapple234_, 31 mar 2026, 1/5: "I paid for this app years ago and used to love it. So it truly pains me to have to leave a negative review. The reward system of planting trees, earning coins and unlocking new species was what made it motivating. Now that’s basically gone. Most new content is locked behind an expensive subscription, and the only free additions are occasional event trees (maybe one or two a month), which just isn’t the same. It feels like the app lost what made it special. As a long-time user, that’s really disappointing."
